root_cause: Push path rules treated an audit-only status file as a change requiring the shared Pages build. That admin report is served as a static file and is explicitly read together with the history in automatic-repair.html.
impact: This push triggered a full shared build with no changes to event records or repair history. The known Ashdod duplicate assertion stopped deployment. The known Ofek validation warning also reappeared.
next_action: The existing event release owner should preserve freshness of the admin status/history through an authorized readback path and separate status-only writes from shared release triggers. Verify a report-only push and a mixed report/catalog push in isolation before changing production. Keep editor-facing report reads and event integrity checks intact.
